title: Scheme-theoretically invariant closed atlas ideals
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal F$ be a category fibred in groupoids over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, and let $p:h_U\to\mathcal F$ be a functor over the base, in the conventions of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. A quasi-coherent ideal $I$ on $U$, in the affine-open ideal-sheaf convention of [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], is invariant if for every $S$-scheme $T$, every two $S$-maps $a,b:T\to U$, and every 2-isomorphism $p\circ h_a\simeq p\circ h_b$ over the base, the scheme-theoretic inverse-image ideals satisfy $a^*I\,\mathcal O_T=b^*I\,\mathcal O_T$. Equivalently, the two inverse images of the closed subscheme $V(I)$ along the self-relation $U\times_{\mathcal F}U$ agree as closed subspaces, tested on all schemes and including their scheme structure. Write $Z_I=V(I)$ over $S$ using $Z_I\hookrightarrow U\to S$, and write $j_I:Z_I\hookrightarrow U$ for its canonical closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. These constructions make no reducedness assumption.
